name: Glute Kickback Machine
steps: Adjust the machine so the pad sits behind one leg, just above the heel or on the back of the thigh, and select a light weight.
Stand facing the machine, hold the handles and keep your chest up and your core tight.
Push the working leg back and up by squeezing your glute, keeping your hips square and your back flat.
Pause at the top without arching your lower back.
Slowly return to the starting position without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish all repetitions, then switch legs.
coaching_cues: Move from the hip, not the lower back
Keep your hips facing the machine
Squeeze the glute at the top of every repetition
